study_title: Cross-Project Heterogeneity in Quality-Oriented Engineering Change
design: Secondary observational analysis of maintenance-intent composition across Apache projects
canonical_source: Trautsch et al. replication dataset on Zenodo
taxonomy_note: The source authors map perfective to internal-quality improvement intent and corrective to external-quality improvement intent. No source row has both flags true; the release treats this as taxonomy structure rather than an empirical negative association.
source_sampling_note: The peer-reviewed article reports a random sample of approximately 2% of eligible commits per project, rounded up, for manual classification.
manual_coding_note: Each sampled commit message was inspected independently by two researchers and disagreements were resolved together.
primary_analysis_note: The complete 54-project table contains 21 expected cells below 5. The n>=20 subset contains no expected cell below 5 and is used as the primary asymptotic analysis.
rights_note: The Zenodo record is open but does not display a specific dataset license value. The peer-reviewed article is CC BY 4.0. This repository therefore avoids republishing manual_labels.csv and stores derived aggregate tables only.
scientific_correction: Version 1.2 retains the three-category taxonomy correction and adds primary-subset residual diagnostics, project-level chi-square contribution decomposition, stronger source verification, and synchronized scientific figures.
claim_boundary: The analysis supports cross-project heterogeneity in sampled maintenance intent. It does not establish project quality rankings, causal project effects, temporal dynamics, engineering-change cost, or schedule impact.
